import json, hashlib, runpy
configs = [p for p in Path('/kaggle/input').rglob('execution-input-contract.json') if 'steptrace-task6-private-inputs-v1-20261011' in p.parts]

from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, runpy

assert v['model_revision'] == '3885219b6810b007914f3a7950a8d1b469d598a5'

assert all((root / a['filename']).stat().st_size == a['bytes'] and sha(root / a['filename']) == a['sha256'] for a in v['artifacts'])
c = json.loads((package / 'execution-input-contract.json').read_text())
assert all((package / a['filename']).stat().st_size == a['bytes'] and sha(package / a['filename']) == a['sha256'] for a in c['model_input_frames'])
